abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description: When used on an allied Hero, make them Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds. When used on an enemy Hero, Slow them by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Cannot be cast on yourself.; 60; trait

fields.notes: Cannot be used on self. Slow on enemy Heroes decays additively by 2.5% per 62.5ms (each server tick) over the 2 second duration. Purge cannot be used on Unstoppable enemies.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.description: Heal an ally with a wave of healing for 260 Health. The wave then bounces 2 times to nearby allies within 7 range, restoring 260 Health to them.

fields.notes: 1) Extended by the radius of the unit the bounce originated from. Can only affect the same unit once per cast. Prioritizes lowest percent Health Hero within bounce range. Chain Heal can bounce to non-Heroes, if there are no Heroes (including those at full Health) in range that it hasn't yet hit during this cast.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.description: Imbue an ally with lightning, dealing 64 damage a second to nearby enemies. Each enemy hit restores 1 Mana to Rehgar. Lasts 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage is dealt simultaneously to all targets in the area. The animation is just for show. Casting Lightning Shield on a unit already affected by it refreshes its duration.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.description: Create a totem that Slows nearby enemies by 35%. The totem has 260 Health and lasts for 6 seconds. Earthbind Totem Earthbind Aura

abilities.name: Ancestral Healing
abilities.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 Health.; 100; 80; heroic

fields.notes: If the target dies before Ancestral Healing goes off, it is put on a 10 second cooldown. Hostile Stasis effects, like Cocoon, prevent Ancestral Healing from resolving and put it on full cooldown. Friendly Stases (e.g. Ice Block) allow the heal to resolve normally. Cannot be cast on a target who is at full Health.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and cause them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.; 90; 70; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Modifier, Lifesteal
fields.notes: Casting does not cancel Ghost Wolf form for Rehgar. 1) Extended by Rehgar's unit radius.

abilities.name: Ghost Wolf
abilities.description: Instead of using a mount, Rehgar transforms into a Ghost Wolf with 20% increased Movement Speed. Basic Attacks in Ghost Wolf form cause him to lunge at his target and deal 60% bonus damage. Dealing damage, using Abilities, and channeling cancels Ghost Wolf form.; 4 / 1.5; mount

fields.type: Movement: Launch, Offensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.notes: Transforming into Ghost Wolf form resets Rehgar's Basic Attack cooldown. The lunge will not happen if the target of the attack is within the minimum range. The Ability can be activated and Rehgar can attack enemies in range from Ghost Wolf Form while Rooted, but the lunge will not happen. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Rehgar's Basic Attack damage. If the lunge is triggered, it will follow an enemy who moves away during its duration so long as it is not disjointed with a Teleport. Using Active Abilities gained from Talents will also cancel this form. Can also be canceled by pressing the Mount button again (which goes on a 1 second cooldown after entering this form).

talents.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%. Questonly Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

talents.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location once. This can be used once per cast. Passive Increase the Area and duration of Earthbind Totem by 50%, and Health by 25%.

fields.notes: 50% increase to Totem radius, therefore the area increase is actually 125%. There is an initial 0.5 second cooldown to move Earthbind Totem.

talents.name: Wellspring
talents.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

fields.notes: The initial instance can only be cast on Heroes, but bounces can target other allied units as well. Otherwise, it has the same properties as the base version of Chain Heal. Wellspring 's Chain Heal uses a separate base value from the original, requiring the given percentage to be calculated multiplicatively with healing dealt modifiers.

talents.name: Elemental Conduit
talents.description: cooldown 70 Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds. For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effect's Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

fields.notes: The duration additional Shields can be gained is indicated by an additional pair of lightning balls circling around Rehgar. Heroes can only gain additional Shields if they received the base Shields. In order to gain additional Shields, affected allies must be within 8 radius of an enemy Hero that is hit by Rehgar's Lightning Shield from this Ability. Every time additional Shields are gained, the duration of the base Shields is set to 4 seconds and the duration of additional Shields to 5 seconds. Lightning Shield from Elemental Conduit benefits from all Talents affecting Lightning Shield.

talents.name: Pit Fighter
talents.description: Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks. While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Bonus to Rehgar himself counts as a stack of Pit Fighter. Heroes in Time Stop, Stasis or special death state do not grant stacks of Pit Fighter. Deathwing does not grant a stack of Pit Fighter. Pit Fighter 's effects are refreshed every 0.25 seconds. Pit Fighter reduces the cooldown of Purge by 0.125 seconds every time it ticks. Attack damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers affecting Rehgar's Basic Attack damage. Spell Power from Pit Fighter stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting the target Hero.
